Moonwell
35% of base mana
2 sec cast2 min cooldown
Creates a zone blessed by moonwell waters for 15 sec at the target location.

All allied players standing within the well receive 25% more healing, and their mana regeneration is increased by 100%.

500206:
Full Moon: This is instant.

New Moon: Triggers a 30 sec reduced cooldown.
